items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: David Thalemur put his name on it.

ctx.x: And, David Thalemur put his name on it. Yeah. Bobby Mitchell's name is not, there's nowhere on that record. So, maybe, maybe, maybe, uh, he should, I don't know, he could get some money. You know, you know, Fats Domino did it, too.
